name: autopia
description: Verified HTTP API behavior at the moment it matters: before an agent's first call to a covered endpoint (api.github.com, registry.npmjs.org, pypi.org, api.anthropic.com, ...), and when such a call fails with a 4xx/5xx. Plus MCP tools to dig further.

autopia_key.title: Autopia API key
autopia_key.description: Optional. Per-user key for the hosted Autopia compendium server (starts with ak_): raises your quota and enables request_target. Reads work anonymously without it.
